integrity: A complete mathematical proof and reproducible direct matrix-power finite-field tests are supplied. Originality is assessed only against the specific inspected literature; no claim of independent external audit or priority certainty.
scientific_limitations: The formula classifies first-depth Jordan profiles in \(m\le p+d\) and at exactly \(m=p+d+1\), not all subsequent truncations. The short-truncation fixed-algebra dimension law was established in earlier work and is not an independent contribution. Finite testing is not a general proof. A closely related 2026 preprint was available only as an abstract, leaving a literature-overlap risk.
title: Tame Jordan rigidity and the first Frobenius collision for truncated Nottingham actions
